title: Machine identity registry
description: Per-BUS-machine identity facts that no other SSOT file states: the ERP machine_ref a machine's orders are booked under, and whether the id mirrors another machine. Every entry must carry the measurement that established it — see mappings/machine-identity.json.

busMachineId.description: The id telemetry is published under (machine_events.machine) — the id every consumer query must use.

erpMachineRef.description: The ERP machine_ref this machine's production orders are booked under. NULL means no binding could be PROVEN; a consumer must then leave the order binding absent rather than guess a similar name.

mirrorOf.description: When set, this id is a second protocol view of the SAME physical machine, already present under the named busMachineId. Mirrors must be excluded from roll-up fan-out (double counting) and from learning (folding one reality in twice narrows the learned variance artificially).

measured.description: What was measured, with the numbers. Required and deliberately long: an identity justified by name similarity alone is a bug even when it happens to be right.

on.description: The date the measurement was taken (YYYY-MM-DD). A pattern, not format:date — ajv-formats is not a dependency here and an ignored format is a check that silently does nothing.

note.description: An open discrepancy between this declaration and something else in the repo or the plant — kept so a human resolves it instead of a consumer quietly overriding it.
